_synthetic: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA. Every person, school, district, provider and message in this file is fictional and was written for this repository. No real child, family, school, district or employee is described. Nothing here is a record of anything that happened.
description: School-side email received by the parent between the first day of school (2026-09-08) and the second-quarter progress report (2027-01-29). Written to the pattern real provider correspondence follows: short, sent by the provider rather than the district, no student id, no minutes, no running total, no committed make-up date. Routine school announcements are interleaved because the parent's inbox does not sort itself.

items.sender: Unified School District Records Office
items.subject: RE: Request for education records
items.body:
Ms. Reyes,

We are in receipt of your correspondence dated November 16, 2026.

Please note that the District does not maintain a service log in the format you have described. Related-service providers keep session notes for their own use; those are the therapist's personal notes and are not part of the educational record.

To proceed, please complete the District's Records Request Form (attached) and return it to the Records Office. Please allow up to 45 days for processing. A records retrieval and administrative fee of $25.00 must be received before your request can be processed. Copies are billed separately at $0.25 per page.

You will receive your child's progress report at the next reporting period, which may address your concerns.

Records Office
Unified School District

items.sender: Ms. P. Nakamura, Director of Special Education, Unified School District
items.subject: Notice regarding speech-language services at Lincoln Elementary
items.body:
Dear Families,

Due to a staffing vacancy in speech-language pathology at Lincoln Elementary, speech-language services at the school are temporarily suspended effective December 8, 2026.

The District is actively recruiting to fill this position and is exploring contracted coverage. We anticipate coverage beginning after the winter break. No impact on student progress is anticipated during this period.

We appreciate your patience.

P. Nakamura
Director of Special Education
